tools.name: sample_tenders
tools.description: FREE. The 5 most recent German public calls for tenders (compact fields) from oeffentlichevergabe.de, optionally filtered by one CPV code or prefix. Data: CC0, personal contact data removed.

tools.name: tender_stats
tools.description: FREE. Imported notices per publication day for the last 30 days, split by kind.

tools.name: describe_api
tools.description: FREE. Endpoints, prices, x402 payment details (USDC on Base), data source and licence, provider and legal notice, how to use the paid tools.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: PAID ($0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402). Full-text and structured search over German public procurement notices (CPV, NUTS, deadline, buyer type, value). This remote server cannot pay on your behalf: the tool returns the exact HTTP URL and payment requirements; use the local MCP server (npx -y g

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: PAID ($0.002 USDC on Base per call via x402). One notice by UUID with lots, deadlines, links and winners. Returns the HTTP URL and payment requirements; pay via the local MCP server or an x402 HTTP client.
